shortDescription: Reference view switcher route for generated screens.
fullDescription: Renders the generated home views from one route by selecting the dashboard-home or user-profile-overview composition through serializable search params. Supports the default state for each generated screen while preserving a single implementation entry point for view audits and previews.

Provides the dashboard-home screen with a state prop supporting the default layout, interactive top and sidebar search fields, a multiline AI prompt composer, selectable prompt controls, feed cards for repository recommendations, and a right rail with promotional and changelog cards. The component is reusable as a presentational dashboard view with configurable initial prompt content and serializable state.

shortDescription: Reusable GitHub-style user profile overview screen.
fullDescription: Provides the user-profile-overview screen with a state prop supporting the default layout, an interactive dark top header with search and action buttons, selectable profile tabs, a profile sidebar with avatar, social metadata, and achievements, repository cards, a contribution settings select, a selectable year rail, and a contribution activity section. The component accepts configurable profile data, selected year, search placeholder, and contribution settings text for reuse across profile views and states.
